name: Creeping-jenny
desc: Creeping-jenny (Lysimachia nummularia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 207 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lysimachia nummularia is a species of flowering plant in the primrose family Primulaceae. Its common names include moneywort, creeping jenny, herb twopence and twopenny grass.
